intro: A Brooklyn trio led by Zach Williams.
story: The Lone Bellow are a Brooklyn trio of Zach Williams, Kanene Donehey Pipkin and Brian Elmquist, signed to Sony's new Descendant imprint in 2012. Their self-titled debut, produced by Charlie Peacock, came out in January 2013, and they came to Pickathon that year. Then Came the Morning followed in 2015, produced by Aaron Dessner of The National, with an Americana Duo/Group of the Year nomination. They are still on the road, with U.S. dates through November 2026 and into early 2027.
